description: This file defines a test scenario class for benchmarking or testing, specifically for scenario 4 with multiple subjects, in the Eclipse Ditto project. It creates and configures a ScenarioSetup instance that models permission grants and revocations for certain subjects and resources, and provides methods to access this setup and apply authorization algorithms.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects24
classes.description: A test scenario class implementing scenario 4 with multiple subjects, which sets up a specific permission scenario and provides methods to retrieve the setup and apply an authorization algorithm.

methods.name: getSetup
methods.description: Returns the ScenarioSetup instance configured for this test scenario.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns a function that applies a PolicyAlgorithm to check permissions based on the setup.
